notes: The tutorial floor's lines (M7-P2), played once by a brand-new profile. One line per step; 'success' shows when the step is done. On the brute step the game uses the guided Counter lines from first-session-lessons.json, not this step's screen line (Manager call, M7-P2), so the brute step is kept here only for its retry/nudge text and the order. The Insight step is automatic with no menu; the real Insight choice is taught in session 3 (lesson-insights). Health never drops below 1 on this floor.
speaker: sensei

lessons.trigger: Tutorial floor starts: bow at the door
screens: Bow at the door to show respect.
Tap where you want to go, or use the stick.

lessons.trigger: Slow brute appears and winds up (game slows, COUNTER pulses)
lessons.retry: Almost! The circle will come again.
lessons.nudge: Take your time. Tap the blue COUNTER button!

lessons.trigger: After the brute: Sensei auto-picks one Insight (no menu, no cards)
screens: Here is an Insight for you!
lessons.success: It will help you on this climb.

screens: A treasure chest! Walk up to open it.
A big one! Watch the circles, like before.
